The verbatim excerpt was extracted PROGRAMMATICALLY from the raw HTML bytes (the field--name-body container): defined terms (bold-italic <strong><em>) written #term#; ordered-list items prefixed with the label the print/PDF render prints ((a),(b) for the outer list; (1),(2) for a nested list; (i),(ii) for a third level); runs of whitespace and non-breaking spaces collapsed to one space and each block trimmed; embedded figures omitted. verbatim_excerpt:
23-232 Floor area provisions for corridors

Floor space in a #building# allocated to corridors may be exempted from #floor area# pursuant to the provisions of paragraphs (a) or (b) of this Section. Such provisions may be applied individually or in combination.

(a) Corridors Termination

Fifty percent of the floor space of a corridor may be exempted from the definition of #floor area# where one of the following criteria are met:

(1) the corridor provides direct access to outdoor space on a balcony or terrace on the same #story# that is accessible to residents of the #story#;

(2) the corridor has daylighting through windows with a glazed area of at least 20 square feet, and such windows are located:

(i) directly within the corridor;

(ii) in the enclosing walls of a stairwell along such corridor, and access to such stairwell from the corridor is provided through an entry door assembly with a minimum glazed area of at least 16 square feet; or

(iii) within common space along such corridor that accessible to residents of the #story#; or

(3) the corridor terminates with a #dwelling unit# that contains at least three bedrooms.

(b) Length of Corridor

Fifty percent of the floor space of a corridor may be exempted from the definition of #floor area#, where the length of the corridor, as measured from the vertical circulation core to the door of the furthest #dwelling unit# on the #story#, does not exceed 100 linear feet. For the purposes of this Section, a vertical circulation core shall refer to an elevator core (consisting of one or more elevators) or, in a non-elevator #building#, to a central stairwell.
verbatim_excerpt_composition: Verbatim blocks joined by a blank line, in page order: [0] the displayed section number and title; then each body paragraph and list item. A list item is written with the label the print/PDF render prints in front of it ((a),(b) outer; (1),(2) nested; (i),(ii) third level), followed by one space; an item's heading line and its text (a double line break in the HTML) are separate blocks. Defined terms (bold-italic in the HTML) are written #term#. Runs of whitespace and non-breaking spaces are written as one space and each block is trimmed; no word was changed. The structured labels were confirmed against the print/PDF render (cross_check: match).
